dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

DeGrom is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. DeGrom is shut down in the care center allowing minimum handing. In the care center, DeGrom has shown extreme behaviors during handling, including intense thrashing, screaming, vocalizing, alligator rolling, defecating, and refusing to walk when leash pressure is applied. In his previous home his family reported DeGrom when comfortable was playful, a couch potato, and enjoyed chewing on durable toys. They also reported DeGrom struggled with general anxiety and showed destructive tendencies when left alone. Medically, DeGrom recently underwent a aural hematoma repair. DeGrom has a history of ear infections but is otherwise healthy at the time.

Degrom was surrendered to the care center by his previous owner, due to barking when left alone. His previous owners describe Degrom as an affectionate dog who is a fun mix of high energy and couch potato, and thinks he is a lap dog. He loves spending time with his family, chewing on bones, and relaxing in sunny spots. Degrom has not acclimated well to the care center environment, and has shown intensely stressed and fearful behavior when handlers have attempted to move him on leash, vocalizing, thrashing, and rolling. His previous owners report that he may escalate to hard barking and growling when startled or approached by unfamiliar people. Due to all noted concerns in the home and care center environment, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
